Hi Alex — appreciate the detailed questions. Quick answers below and I've looped in Neha (security) and Rishi (sales engineering) to handle the questionnaire + pen-test access: 

- SOC 2: Confirmed, Type II, covers infrastructure, change management, logical access, and availability (covering audit period Jan 12, 2025). See attached summary.
- Pen-test: We can share the unredacted report under NDA. Our legal/security team typically requests 5-7 business days to review and redact any sensitive PII or vendor details before transfer.
- Disclosure policy: We have a coordinated disclosure process — customers are notified for any critical findings within 24 hours of confirmation; for high findings within 72 hours. Internal remediation targets align with severity (critical: immediate mitigation plan within 72 hours; high: mitigation plan within 7 days).

Hi Alex — quick note from engineering on scanning cadence and vuln management: 

- Scanning cadence: weekly authenticated internal scans (Nessus/Qualys) + daily external surface monitoring. Annual third-party pentest + after-major-release tests for infra changes.
- Triage & SLAs: Critical CVEs: ack within 24 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours. High: ack within 72 hours, plan within 7 days. Medium/low: prioritized in regular sprint/patch cycles, target remediation in next 30-90 days depending on impact.
- Disclosure: we do customer-impact-first notifications. Post-investigation we share a remediation summary and any recommended customer mitigations (e.g., config guidance). We redact exploitable PoCs from shared reports.

If you want more granular SLAs for dedicated/private deployments, we can include contractual language in the SOW.

-David
David Kim
Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference
